metadata.title: SFTC Volleyball Teaching And Planning Database
metadata.description: App-facing volleyball teaching, role, tactical, S&C, injury, macro-planning, and retrieval records derived from structured volleyball research drafts.

sport_profiles.planning_summary: Indoor volleyball is a repeated-jump, overhead, transition-based court sport. Planning should balance jump/landing exposure, shoulder contact load, role-specific court skill, match schedule, and recovery.
do_not_pair: high-volume lower-body plyometrics with heavy lower-body strength on the same fatigue-limited day
new jump-serve volume with high overhead pressing volume
max jump testing during knee or patellar tendon pain
high soreness lower-body work within 24 hours of important matches
progression_guardrails: progress jump volume and intensity separately
use pain and next-day response to adjust jumping and overhead contacts
unlock advanced jump-serve, swing-block, and tempo attack work only after landing and shoulder tolerance are stable
reduce gym novelty during tournament or heavy match weeks
